auth.title: Authentication & User Management API
auth.problem: Many internal tools need secure user access without relying on large external identity systems.
auth.solution: A FastAPI authentication service with JWT login, protected user access, role-based permissions, validation, and PostgreSQL persistence.
auth.businessValue: Reusable authentication backend for dashboards, admin panels, and internal tools where secure access control matters.
auth.productionThinking: Built with role-based access control, JWT validation, password hashing, database migrations, structured input validation, and environment-based configuration for reliable API behavior.
auth.screenshot: Interactive demo available in the project view.

classifier.title: AI-assisted Image Classification API
classifier.problem: Teams often need a fast way to classify uploaded visual content without investing in dedicated ML infrastructure.
classifier.solution: A FastAPI service that accepts uploaded images, performs CLIP-based zero-shot classification, supports custom labels or presets, and returns structured JSON predictions.
classifier.businessValue: Enables image search, content moderation, or automated tagging without building in-house ML infrastructure.
classifier.productionThinking: Upload validation, file handling, lazy model loading, configurable confidence thresholds, structured API responses, and explicit error handling.
classifier.screenshot: Interactive demo available in the project view.

imageProcessing.title: Image Processing API
imageProcessing.problem: Teams waste time manually resizing, converting, or rotating images using desktop tools or scattered scripts.
imageProcessing.solution: A FastAPI service that accepts image uploads and applies resizing, grayscale conversion, or rotation through API-driven processing and downloadable PNG output.
imageProcessing.businessValue: Automates repetitive image operations, improves output consistency, and enables integration with internal workflows or content pipelines.
imageProcessing.productionThinking: MIME validation, upload size limits, deterministic output formatting, image decoding safeguards, and safe in-memory processing without temporary file leaks.
imageProcessing.screenshot: Interactive demo available in the project view.

projects.pwnedDesc: Python API using the k-Anonymity method with the HaveIBeenPwned API to check whether a password has appeared in data breaches.
projects.imgDesc: Python API for image processing (resize, grayscale, rotate). It supports file uploads, image processing, and returning the modified file through an API endpoint.
projects.imgClassDesc: Python API that accepts an image and returns a classification using an ML model. The endpoint handles file uploads and returns prediction results in JSON format.
projects.authDesc: API for user management with registration, login, and JWT authentication. The system supports user roles (admin/user), profiles, and integration with a PostgreSQL database using SQLAlchemy.

pwnedProject.title: Pwned Password Check
pwnedProject.desc: Check whether a password has appeared in data breaches. The backend uses the k-Anonymity method with Have I Been Pwned, so the full password is never sent.
pwnedProject.archDesc: The backend exposes an API endpoint that accepts a password, generates its SHA-1 hash, and communicates with the HaveIBeenPwned API to check whether the password has appeared in data breaches.
pwnedProject.how1: The backend calculates the SHA-1 hash of the password and sends only the first 5 characters to the API.
pwnedProject.how2: HaveIBeenPwned returns a list of matching hashes and the number of times they appear.
pwnedProject.how3: The backend compares the remaining part of the hash locally and returns the result.

imageEditor.title: Image Editor (Python API)
imageEditor.desc: Backend API for on-demand image processing with resize, grayscale conversion, rotation, preview, and PNG export.
imageEditor.archDesc: The project consists of a Python backend that handles file uploads and image processing operations such as resizing, grayscale conversion, and rotation. The operations are performed on the API side, and the frontend displays the result as a preview before the file is downloaded.

imageClassifier.title: Image Classifier (ML)
imageClassifier.desc: Backend API for CLIP-based image classification with structured JSON responses and configurable prediction settings.
imageClassifier.archDesc: The backend exposes an API endpoint that accepts an image uploaded by the user, prepares it for prediction (preprocessing), and then passes it to the machine learning model. The model returns a list of the most probable classes along with their assigned probabilities, which the API returns in a JSON response.
imageClassifier.warningDesc: The model loads on first request to reduce memory usage in the hosting environment.
imageClassifier.smartTip: Smart mode uses predefined backend-side category presets.
imageClassifier.presetsError: Could not load presets from the API.
imageClassifier.manualTip: Manual mode: type your own labels (comma-separated). CLIP matches image to text.

auth.title: Auth & User Management API
auth.desc: Authentication backend with JWT login, role-based access, PostgreSQL persistence, and protected API routes.
auth.archDesc: The project consists of a FastAPI backend that handles user registration, login, and access to protected endpoints. User data is stored in a PostgreSQL database using SQLAlchemy, and passwords are secured with bcrypt hashing. After successful login, the backend generates a JWT token used to authorize subsequent requests, and access to selected resources is controlled based on the user’s role, such as admin or user.
auth.tokenMissing: Use demo credentials to test the authentication flow.
auth.tokenOk: JWT token active — requests include Authorization: Bearer token.
